outcome: Atopic dermatitis (AD) at 3 years of age
Persistent AD (eczema in the first year and at 3 years, with AD diagnosis by 3 years)
cohort: 2129 mother-child pairs from the Scandinavian population-based prospective PreventADALL cohort
finding: Caesarean section was associated with increased odds of atopic dermatitis by 3 years of age, particularly early onset AD, but not with persistent AD.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with increased odds of atopic dermatitis by 3 years of age, particularly in infants presenting with eczema at 3 months of age.
